zh: 每个回文子串都有唯一的中心：长度为奇数时中心是一个字符，长度为偶数时中心在两个字符之间。所以只要知道每个中心能向外扩展多远，就能直接数出以它为中心的回文个数。
以某个中心的最长回文半径为 k，就恰好有 k 个以它为中心的回文（半径 1..k）。对每个中心暴力扩展最坏是 O(n²)，用 Manacher 算法借助已知最右回文的镜像位置可以把总时间降到 O(n)。
分别做奇数中心数组 d1 和偶数中心数组 d2：维护当前右端最远的回文区间 [l,r]，i 在区间内时用镜像位置的半径与 r−i+1 的较小值作为初值，再继续暴力扩展，并在超出 r 时更新 [l,r]。答案是所有 d1[i] 与 d2[i] 之和，可达约 2×10^10，用 64 位整数。
en: Every palindromic substring has a unique center: a character for odd length, or the gap between two characters for even length. So if you know how far each center can expand, you can count the palindromes around it directly.

If the longest palindrome around a center has radius k, there are exactly k palindromes with that center (radii 1..k). Expanding every center by brute force is O(n^2) in the worst case; Manacher's algorithm reuses the mirror position inside the rightmost known palindrome to bring the total down to O(n).

Build an odd-center array d1 and an even-center array d2. Keep the palindrome [l, r] that reaches furthest right; when i lies inside it, start from the smaller of the mirror position's radius and r - i + 1, then keep expanding, and update [l, r] when you pass r. The answer is the sum of all d1[i] and d2[i], which can reach about 2 * 10^10, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use Manacher's algorithm to compute, for every center, the longest odd and even palindrome radius. Each center's radius is the number of palindromic substrings around that center; add them all up.

## Correctness

For each odd center, radius k represents the k palindromes of lengths 1 through 2k-1; likewise an even center corresponds to the k palindromes of lengths 2 through 2k. Manacher's expansion and mirror reuse only change how efficiently the radii are found, without missing or repeating a center, so every position pair is counted exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
